full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
Federal Parliament
Notice - 4
Nepal
Chaitra 25, 2082
Wednesday
Joint Meeting
Information Regarding Convening
As per Article 94 of the Constitution of Nepal, the Honorable Ram Chandra Poudel, President, will address the joint meeting of both houses of the Federal Parliament on Chaitra 27, 2082, at 3:00 PM. This notice is published for the information of the members of the Federal Parliament. Members of the Federal Parliament are requested to be present in their respective seats in the Joint Meeting Hall, Singha Durbar, by 2:45 PM on the said day and take their seats.

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: A notice is published informing members of the Federal Parliament about a joint meeting. The President, Ram Chandra Poudel, will address the joint meeting of both houses of the Federal Parliament on Chaitra 27, 2082, at 3:00 PM.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: Members of the Federal Parliament are requested to be present in their respective seats in the Joint Meeting Hall by 2:45 PM on the day of the address.

sections.name: Adjournment
sections.summary_en: The notice concludes with the signature of the Secretary-General.
